topic: Financing a big wedding on credit vs setting a guest cap and a cash only budget (Gilbert vs Gretchen)

scenes.narration: The average wedding now costs more than a new car. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled TWO HUNDRED GUESTS and SIXTY GUESTS, comic burst banner reads COSTS MORE THAN A CAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gilbert and Gretchen both get engaged the same spring.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man gilbert and woman gretchen each holding up a ring box, spring flowers, sparkles, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each has twelve thousand dollars saved for the big day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two matching piggy banks on a gym bench each labeled TWELVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gilbert invites two hundred guests and books the venue on a credit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gilbert swiping a credit card at a grand ballroom, a guest list scroll unrolling reading TWO HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bill hits thirty five thousand at twenty four percent interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a giant wedding receipt reading THIRTY FIVE THOUSAND with a red interest tag reading TWENTY FOUR PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The honeymoon ends. The payments last five more years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gilbert at a kitchen table with a calendar flipping five years, a monthly payment stub, tired face, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gretchen caps the list at sixty guests and pays cash only.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gretchen writing SIXTY on a whiteboard guest cap, a cash envelope labeled WEDDING FUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She books a Friday, hires a food truck, and borrows the dress.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gretchen at a park venue with a food truck, a calendar circled FRIDAY, a borrowed dress on a hanger, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Total spent, eleven thousand. Left over, one thousand for the honeymoon.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clipboard tally reading ELEVEN THOUSAND SPENT and ONE THOUSAND LEFT, a suitcase with a beach sticker, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every vendor knew the number and nobody got to push past it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gretchen holding a firm budget card to a line of vendors, a line reads THE NUMBER IS THE NUMBER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gilbert starts marriage twenty three thousand in debt. Gretchen starts at zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man gilbert dragging a ball and chain labeled TWENTY THREE THOUSAND, woman gretchen jogging free with a ZERO DEBT flag, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Set the guest cap first, then the budget. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading GUEST CAP FIRST, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
